text_en: The Lord spoke to Moses, saying:
text_cn: 上主训示梅瑟说：

text_en: Command the Israelites, and say to them: When you enter the land of Canaan (this is the land that shall fall to you for an inheritance, the land of Canaan, defined by its boundaries),
text_cn: “你命令以色列子民说：你们几时进入客纳罕地，这地应是你们抽签分配的产业。客纳罕地的边界是：

text_en: your south sector shall extend from the wilderness of Zin along the side of Edom. Your southern boundary shall begin from the end of the Dead Sea on the east;
text_cn: 你们南部的地区，是由亲旷野直到厄东边境。你们南方的边界是：由盐海的极端往东，

text_en: your boundary shall turn south of the ascent of Akrabbim, and cross to Zin, and its outer limit shall be south of Kadesh-barnea; then it shall go on to Hazar-addar, and cross to Azmon;
text_cn: 绕过阿刻辣宾高地的南部，经过亲直达卡德士巴尔乃亚南部，再到哈匝尔阿达尔，经过阿兹孟，

text_en: the boundary shall turn from Azmon to the Wadi of Egypt, and its termination shall be at the Sea.
text_cn: 由阿兹孟边界再转向埃及河，直到大海。

text_en: For the western boundary, you shall have the Great Sea and its coast; this shall be your western boundary.
text_cn: 西部的边界：大海作你们的边界，这是你们西方的边界。

text_en: This shall be your northern boundary: from the Great Sea you shall mark out your line to Mount Hor;
text_cn: 你们北方的边界如下：由大海划界，直到曷尔山；

text_en: from Mount Hor you shall mark it out to Lebo-hamath, and the outer limit of the boundary shall be at Zedad;
text_cn: 由曷尔山划到哈玛特关口，使边界直达责辣得。

text_en: then the boundary shall extend to Ziphron, and its end shall be at Hazar-enan; this shall be your northern boundary.
text_cn: 这边界再伸至齐弗龙，直达哈匝尔厄南：这是你们北方的边界。

text_en: You shall mark out your eastern boundary from Hazar-enan to Shepham;
text_cn: 你们东部的边界：自哈匝尔厄南划到舍番。

text_en: and the boundary shall continue down from Shepham to Riblah on the east side of Ain; and the boundary shall go down, and reach the eastern slope of the sea of Chinnereth;
text_cn: 由舍番边界下延至阿殷东面的黎贝拉； 由此边界，再下延与基乃勒特海东岸相接。

text_en: and the boundary shall go down to the Jordan, and its end shall be at the Dead Sea. This shall be your land with its boundaries all around.
text_cn: 此后，边界再沿约但河下延，直达盐海：这是你们疆土四周的边界。”

text_en: Moses commanded the Israelites, saying: This is the land that you shall inherit by lot, which the Lord has commanded to give to the nine tribes and to the half-tribe;
text_cn: 梅瑟又吩咐以色列子民说：“这就是你们应抽签分为产业的地方，是上主命令分给九个半支派的，

text_en: for the tribe of the Reubenites by their ancestral houses and the tribe of the Gadites by their ancestral houses have taken their inheritance, and also the half-tribe of Manasseh;
text_cn: 因为勒乌本子孙支派和加得子孙支派，为自己的家族已取得产业；默纳协半支派也取得了自己的产业；

text_en: the two tribes and the half-tribe have taken their inheritance beyond the Jordan at Jericho eastward, toward the sunrise.
text_cn: 这两个半支派，已在耶里哥对面，约但河东岸，向日出之地，取得了产业。”

text_en: The Lord spoke to Moses, saying:
text_cn: 上主又训示梅瑟说：

text_en: These are the names of the men who shall apportion the land to you for inheritance: the priest Eleazar and Joshua son of Nun.
text_cn: “这是给你们分配土地的人名：厄肋阿匝尔大司祭和农的儿子若苏厄；

text_en: You shall take one leader of every tribe to apportion the land for inheritance.
text_cn: 此外由每支派选派一位首领来分配土地；

text_en: These are the names of the men: Of the tribe of Judah, Caleb son of Jephunneh.
text_cn: 这些人的名字就是：犹大支派，是耶孚乃的儿子加肋布；

text_en: Of the tribe of the Simeonites, Shemuel son of Ammihud.
text_cn: 西默盎子孙支派，是阿米胡得的儿子舍慕耳；

text_en: Of the tribe of Benjamin, Elidad son of Chislon.
text_cn: 本雅明支派，是基斯隆的儿子厄里达得；

text_en: Of the tribe of the Danites a leader, Bukki son of Jogli.
text_cn: 丹子孙支派的首领，是约革里的儿子步克；

text_en: Of the Josephites: of the tribe of the Manassites a leader, Hanniel son of Ephod,
text_cn: 若瑟子孙：默纳协子孙支派的首领，是厄缶（fǒu）得的儿子哈尼耳；

text_en: and of the tribe of the Ephraimites a leader, Kemuel son of Shiphtan.
text_cn: 厄弗辣因子孙支派的首领，是色弗堂的儿子刻慕耳；

text_en: Of the tribe of the Zebulunites a leader, Eli-zaphan son of Parnach.
text_cn: 则步隆子孙支派的首领，是帕尔纳客的儿子厄里匝番；

text_en: Of the tribe of the Issacharites a leader, Paltiel son of Azzan.
text_cn: 依撒加尔子孙支派的首领，是阿仓的儿子帕耳提耳；

text_en: And of the tribe of the Asherites a leader, Ahihud son of Shelomi.
text_cn: 阿协尔子孙支派的首领，是舍罗米的儿子阿希胡得；

text_en: Of the tribe of the Naphtalites a leader, Pedahel son of Ammihud.
text_cn: 纳斐塔里子孙支派的首领，是阿米胡得的儿子培达赫耳。”

text_en: These were the ones whom the Lord commanded to apportion the inheritance for the Israelites in the land of Canaan.
text_cn: 这些人是上主任命，为在客纳罕地给以色列子民分配产业的人。
